stops.note: literally 'I'll leave it up to you', a customer's phrase entrusting the meal to the chef
stops.meaning: leaving the menu choice to the chef

stops.note: borrowed by sushi restaurants and diners as chef's-choice dining spread in the West
stops.meaning: a chef's-choice tasting menu, especially at sushi restaurants

current_meaning: a dining style, especially at sushi restaurants, in which the chef selects the dishes for the guest
